subject: English Core
title: A Thing of Beauty — Poem 3 DPP

questions.question: What does the poet imply when he says "A thing of beauty is a joy forever"?
options: Beautiful things last forever physically
Beauty has lasting psychological and emotional value
Beauty is always expensive and valuable
Only natural beauty brings joy
questions.explanation: Beauty has lasting psychological and emotional value

questions.question: Why does the poet use images like “gloomy days,” “despondence,” and “inhuman dearth”?
options: To praise beauty more eﬀectively
To exaggerate human joy
To show the need for natural beauty as an escape from life's hardships
To show the poet’s hatred towards life
questions.explanation: To show the need for natural beauty as an escape from life's hardships

questions.question: How does the idea of the "bower" symbolize beauty in the poem?
options: It represents the commercial value of nature
It is a literal resting place for people
It signiﬁes a permanent shelter created by beauty in our imagination
It is a part of religious worship
questions.explanation: It signiﬁes a permanent shelter created by beauty in our imagination

questions.question: Why is beauty referred to as a “ﬂowery band”?
options: It is meant to describe a physical garland
It highlights how nature traps us in illusions
It represents how beauty connects us gently to life despite hardships
It shows beauty’s fragility
questions.explanation: It represents how beauty connects us gently to life despite hardships

questions.question: What does the phrase “simple sheep” most likely symbolize in the context of the poem?
options: Ordinary rural life
Innocence and peacefulness
Stubbornness of humans
Religious imagery

questions.question: Why does the poet consider the “sun, moon, trees” as things of beauty?
options: They are rare and expensive
They are reminders of the divine order of life
They bring spiritual and emotional solace despite life's trials
They are often mentioned in poetry
questions.explanation: They bring spiritual and emotional solace despite life's trials

questions.question: What does the phrase “an endless fountain of immortal drink” imply?
options: To describe literal water sources
To suggest that beauty nourishes the soul endlessly
To show the power of wealth
To represent modern life
questions.explanation: To suggest that beauty nourishes the soul endlessly

questions.question: The line “Some shape of beauty moves away the pall / From our dark spirits” implies that—
options: Beauty is a momentary distraction from grief
Beauty can remove gloom and despair from our minds
Beauty makes us forget responsibilities
Beauty brings confusion to the soul
questions.explanation: Beauty can remove gloom and despair from our minds

questions.question: What does the line, ‘Therefore, are we wreathing a ﬂowery band to bind us to earth’ suggest?
options: We are creating beauty to escape the hardships of life.
We are binding ourselves to the earth through beautiful things.
We are using ﬂowers to symbolize our journey to the afterlife.
We are trying to escape sorrow through imagination. | | Android App iOS App PW Website DPP: 9 Parishram 2027 English A Thing of Beauty
questions.explanation: The line refers to how beauty and nature connect us to life and the world around us, even amidst suﬀering.

questions.question: Why is ‘grandeur’ associated with the ‘mighty dead’?
options: Because they were powerful rulers who shaped history.
Because their wealth and possessions are now a part of history.
Because their heroic deeds and sacriﬁces are remembered and celebrated.
Because they were associated with mythical stories of grandeur. | | Android App iOS App PW Website
questions.explanation: Because their heroic deeds and sacri ﬁces are remembered and celebrated.
